uzo.purpose: Shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy and links back up to each level; the first item may show an icon (slot icon-start).

instead.kialo: The places beside the page are a navigation, because a breadcrumb shows the ancestors above it, not the siblings; that is the navigado.
The steps of a process are no path up a hierarchy, because their order is the process and the person may not jump back freely; Fundamento has no step indicator yet, a person decides.

boundary.kialo: A level that opens a list of its sibling pages is not supported, because the item would move up and choose sideways at once; the trail leads up only, the pages beside one level belong to the navigado.

containers.name: page-header
containers.kialo: A breadcrumb stands at the head of the page above its heading, because the person reads where they are before what is there.

with.kialo: Its items are links, because each one moves up to a level; the last one, the current page, is text.
The separator between two items is the ikono chevron-right, decorative, because it points down the path and mirrors in right-to-left writing.
The middle of a long trail collapses into a menu (max-items), because the levels cut away must stay reachable; its entries are links, each moves up to its level.
